Asset type: standalone food illustration for a Chinese travel guide card, horizontal 3:2 composition.
Style: refined editorial watercolor and gouache on warm ivory paper, clearly painted rather than photographic. Restrained background, appetizing food texture, centered single dish with room for card cropping.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no packaging, no hands, no identifiable restaurant, no collage, no unrelated side dishes. Depict this named dish accurately without implying an actual merchant serving.

Subject: one shallow ceramic bowl containing pale cream-yellow semi-opaque pea or broad-bean starch jelly cut into thick short rectangular strips, dressed with a little reddish chili oil sauce and finely chopped green scallions.
